title: Hotfix: streaming final message assembly corner-case (structured output examples)
author: Ibrahim Khan
release_notes: - Fixes a rare streaming corner-case where the final assistant message could drop the last content/tool-call delta, causing invalid JSON in structured-output examples and flaky golden transcript tests.
description:
Context: During the streaming examples refresh we started running structured-output (schema-constrained) snippets against real streaming responses in smoke tests. We saw intermittent JSON parse failures and transcript diffs where the final assistant message was missing the last ~1–30 characters. Support reported similar symptoms in SUP-18436 (“structured output sometimes emits invalid JSON”), but logs suggested the model output was complete and the truncation happened client-side/assembly-side in our example harness.

Incident-style notes (what happened / impact): 1) On Feb 13–14 UTC the redwood-examples structured-output sample failed ~3/40 runs in CI with JSON parse errors (missing closing brace/quote). 2) The docs snippet sync check (pr-14621) flagged a mismatch between the golden transcript and the assembled final message for a tool-calling + structured output flow. 3) No production outage, but this directly impacted the “copy/paste works” goal for the docs refresh and increased support load due to confusing “model returned invalid JSON” errors.

Root cause: Our server-side streaming transcript assembler (used by tests + snippet validation) incorrectly handled the final aggregation when an assistant message ends with a non-content delta (e.g., a tool_call delta or a final “message_end” / “response_completed” marker). Specifically, in a narrow ordering the assembler would treat the terminal event as authoritative and overwrite the in-progress assistant message rather than finalizing it. This was most visible in structured output because losing a few trailing characters often makes JSON invalid.

Fix: 1) Make finalization idempotent and monotonic: once we have an assistant message id, we never replace the accumulated content string—only append deltas and merge structured fields (tool_calls) by stable indexes. 2) If we receive a terminal event without a final content delta, we finalize using the current accumulator rather than creating a new empty message frame. 3) Add a regression test covering the exact event ordering seen in failing runs (assistant_content_delta* -> tool_call_delta -> response_completed). 4) Improve debug logging in the harness to print event ordering when JSON validation fails (behind RW_EXAMPLES_DEBUG=1).

Why this is safe: No API surface changes. This only changes how we assemble/validate streaming transcripts used by examples/docs checks and internal smoke tests; it matches the streaming event model conventions (accumulate deltas, finalize on terminal event, never drop previously received deltas).

Rollout/backport: Merging to main; no backport planned unless we see this affecting other CI lanes. Docs/examples CI will pick this up immediately. If SUP-18436 continues after this merge, we should request raw streamed chunks from the customer to confirm whether it’s still assembly-side or truly model-side variability.

Testing: - Added unit regression test for event ordering (passes locally). - Ran examples smoke tests (structured output + tool calling) 50x with debug enabled: no failures. - Verified snippet sync check passes with updated fixture.

Related: ENG-4822 (golden tests for streaming tool calls), ENG-4826 (docs streaming pages update).
commits_summary: streaming: make final message assembly monotonic and idempotent
tests: add regression fixture for terminal event ordering
harness: add optional debug logging on JSON validation failures
review_conversation: Brian Murphy (review): The overwrite behavior makes sense given the terminal event path. Can you confirm we never create a second assistant message frame on response_completed for the same message_id after this change? Also, please add a test for the ordering where tool_call delta arrives after the last content delta (the one described in the PR body).

Ibrahim Khan (author): Yep—post-change, message_id is the key: we finalize the existing accumulator and explicitly avoid allocating a fresh assistant frame on terminal events. Added a regression test using the exact ordering we saw in CI (content deltas -> tool_call delta -> response_completed).
Sahana Iyer (review): CI flake history: do we have any nondeterminism left in the fixture generation? Please ensure the fixture is static and not generated from a live model call in tests.
Ibrahim Khan (author): Fixture is static JSONL committed under tests/streaming/fixtures. No network/model calls in unit tests; the only live calls are in the separate examples smoke workflow.

Wei Chen (review): From docs POV: can we add a one-line note to the internal debug output to point folks at the streaming conventions doc if JSON validation fails? Not required for this hotfix, but it’ll help triage.
Ibrahim Khan (author): Added a debug line gated on RW_EXAMPLES_DEBUG=1 that prints event types and points to the internal conventions page; left user-facing output unchanged.
Brian Murphy (approval): Looks good. The accumulator semantics now match the documented model: append deltas, finalize on terminal event. Approved.
Sahana Iyer (approval): Approved. Thanks for keeping the tests offline/static.
